sql.query: SELECT ct.id,ct.templateName,ct.description,ct.bodyHtml,ct.versionNumber,ct.isActive FROM tbl_contract_templates ct WHERE ct.id=:id AND ct.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=:moduleTenant AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=:roleTenant AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1

SELECT v.versionNumber,v.createdDate,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown') createdBy FROM tbl_contract_template_versions v LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=v.createdByUserId WHERE v.templateId=:id AND v.tenantId=:tenantId ORDER BY v.versionNumber DESC
